description: This file defines a class 'ScheduledDraftModal' for automating interactions with a scheduled draft modal component in a web UI, using Playwright for end-to-end testing.

classes.name: ScheduledDraftModal
classes.description: A class representing the scheduled draft modal component, providing methods to interact with date and time inputs, and to verify visibility.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Asserts that the modal container is visible.

methods.name: getDaySuffix
methods.description: Returns the appropriate suffix ('st', 'nd', 'rd', 'th') for a given day number.

methods.name: dateLocator
methods.description: Constructs a locator for a specific date button based on day, month, and day of week.

methods.name: selectDay
methods.description: Selects a day in the date picker, optionally offset from today.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Clicks the confirm button to finalize the selection.

methods.name: selectTime
methods.description: Selects the first available time option from the dropdown.

methods.name: getPacificDate
methods.description: Returns the current date and time converted to Pacific Time.
